payload.text: NEXT GLOBALFOLD, LESSONS.md candidates from devbin-cc (2026-09-22 night, grep-checked absent from LESSONS.md): (1) In the Claude Code Bash tool, grep is a snapshot function running embedded ugrep with --ignore-files, so grep -r silently skips anything a .gitignore inside the searched tree excludes. cc measured it: 1 of 2 identical files found, rc=0; /usr/bin/grep -r found both. (2) The same ugrep refuses a bounded-context pattern like .{0,90}word.{0,90} with rc=2 and no output, which reads as 'no match' unless the status is printed. (3) intent issues list shows OPEN issues only, so its silence cannot mean CLOSED; use --kind closed. (4) cc watch-out 12 carries three more: BSD cmp -n reaching EOF, a remote-tracking ref taken for the remote, and jq over board.json counting archived rows.
